verdict.rationale: CSC's own documentation states, on several pages, that it serves as registered agent in all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia. It also provides service-of-process representation in every state, so a founder expanding into a new state can stay with the same vendor. A single dashboard showing entity information across all jurisdictions reinforces the one-provider experience. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the nationwide coverage claim.
